q: The Pinsker algebra Π(T) of an ergodic MPT T is the largest T-invariant sub-σ-algebra with zero entropy. The factor T/Π(T) is the Pinsker factor, and T is a:
opts: Kronecker system if Π(T) is the whole algebra
Bernoulli system if Π(T) is trivial (the zero-entropy factor is trivial, and T has completely positive entropy)
Weakly mixing system if Π(T) contains the invariant sets
exp: Completely positive entropy (CPE) means Π(T) is trivial: no non-trivial sub-σ-algebra has zero entropy. Bernoulli systems have CPE (Thouvenot). The Pinsker factor is the 'zero-entropy part'; factoring it out leaves a CPE system, which by Thouvenot's theorem on factors is Bernoulli up to a zero-entropy extension.
